question: In its proposal for a Council recommendation on screening for cardiovascular disease (COM(2026)481), the European Commission recognises obesity as a significant risk factor. It includes body mass index assessment among the recommended screening tests.

However, European medical and patient organisations are calling for obesity to be treated more consistently as a chronic, relapsing condition requiring early diagnosis, systematic monitoring and access to treatment.

In this connection: Will the Commission propose extending the assessment of cardiovascular risk in people under 35 to include waist circumference and waist-to-height ratio, alongside body mass index, which is already provided for?
